errors.title: We couldn’t complete that step
errors.invalidCredentials: The email and password didn’t match. Check both, or reset your password.
errors.emailAlreadyUsed: An account already uses this email. Sign in or reset your password.
errors.emailUnverified: Verify your email before signing in. Open your verification email and follow the link.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address and try again.
errors.passwordTooShort: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
errors.shopifyStoreNotFound: We couldn’t find that Shopify store. Enter its public store address or its myshopify.com domain.
errors.google: Google sign-in couldn’t start. Try again or continue with email.
errors.shopify: Shopify sign-in couldn’t start. Check the store address and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.unavailable: We couldn’t connect just now. Try again in a moment. If the problem continues, contact support.
errors.signIn: We couldn’t sign you in. Try again or reset your password.
errors.signUp: We couldn’t create your account. Check the details and try again.
errors.forgotPassword: We couldn’t send the reset link. Try again in a moment.
errors.resetPassword: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new link, then try again.
errors.completeProfile: We couldn’t save your profile. Try again. If the problem continues, contact support.
